contract.proof: Blocked views descend one balanced block path; packed and dense views use direct indexed reads.
contract.adversarialWitness: Read the final item of a maximum-depth blocked owner.

fullScan.rationale: One indexed read cannot visit unrelated blocks.

contract.proof: Iteration visits each retained block and item exactly once without array materialization.
contract.adversarialWitness: Consume a maximum-size view to iterator completion.

fullScan.rationale: Explicit iteration requests the complete logical collection.

contract.proof: toArray allocates one output array and fills each position once from the retained owner.

fullScan.rationale: The explicit snapshot output itself contains every item.

contract.proof: Prefix-sum lookup descends the balanced extent index by one branch per level.
contract.adversarialWitness: Lookup at the final offset of a maximum-size non-uniform extent index.

fullScan.rationale: Indexed offset lookup must not visit every extent.

contract.proof: Each changed extent path-copies one balanced prefix-index path; anchor reads are logarithmic.
contract.adversarialWitness: Changed extents occupy disjoint leaves so no copied index path is shared.

fullScan.rationale: Sparse measurements may not visit unchanged extents.

contract.proof: Gap-aware range search performs bounded logarithmic prefix lookups, then emits each render-window placement once.
contract.adversarialWitness: Non-zero gaps force the nested range search and the viewport emits kPlacement items.

fullScan.rationale: A full visit is permitted only when output kPlacement equals nItem.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(nItem log lLane + jChanged log nItem)

time.bound: O(nItem log lLane + jChanged log nItem)

contract.proof: Extent updates path-copy index paths and cascading lane placement recomputes from the first changed item.
contract.adversarialWitness: Changing the first item under balanced shortest-lane placement reflows every later item.

fullScan.rationale: Cascading shortest-lane ownership can make every later placement observably change.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(vLane log nItem + kPlacement log kPlacement)

time.bound: O(vLane log nItem + kPlacement log kPlacement)

contract.proof: Each visible lane binary-searches its first overlap, emits candidates, then restores domain order by sorting the output.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every visible lane contributes interleaved placements requiring the output sort.

fullScan.rationale: Unrelated offscreen lane entries must be skipped by binary search.

variables.name: nTrack
variables.meaning: partitioned row and column track count

contract.proof: Identity maps locate changed tracks; blocked vectors and prefix indexes path-copy bounded paths while region indexes and partition boundaries retain owner identity.
contract.adversarialWitness: Changed tracks occupy disjoint 64-entry blocks across both axes while remaining below the half-rebuild crossover.

fullScan.rationale: Sparse measurement may not visit unchanged tracks or regions.

variables.name: nTrack
variables.meaning: partitioned row and column track count

contract.proof: When the deterministic repair bound reaches half the track count, one packed rebuild replaces track, prefix, partition, and region indexes.
contract.adversarialWitness: A dense batch changes every track and forces the selected rebuild branch.

fullScan.rationale: The crossover explicitly selects one full rebuild for dense changes.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(log nRegion + cCandidate + kPlacement log kPlacement)

time.bound: O(log nRegion + cCandidate + kPlacement log kPlacement)

contract.proof: A bounded 3x3 partition set queries nested indexes, deduplicates candidates by ID, projects them, and sorts emitted placements.
contract.adversarialWitness: Regions span pinned and center partitions so every partition query returns duplicate/interleaved candidates.

fullScan.rationale: Only index candidates and emitted placements may be visited.

variables.name: rRepair
variables.meaning: selected blocked-vector and packed-tree repair bound

contract.proof: Retained ID and item-to-leaf indexes identify changes; sorted change sets path-copy 64-entry vector leaves and only touched packed-tree paths.
contract.adversarialWitness: Changed rectangles occupy distinct spatial leaves while the explicit repair bound remains below half the item count.

fullScan.rationale: Sparse measurement may not visit unchanged items or packed-tree leaves.

contract.proof: When the deterministic repair bound reaches half the item count, one STR sort and packed-tree rebuild replaces the owner.
contract.adversarialWitness: A dense measurement changes every rectangle and forces the selected rebuild branch.

fullScan.rationale: The crossover explicitly selects one full packed rebuild for dense changes.

contract.proof: Packed-tree intersection prunes non-overlapping branches and emits each matching placement once.
contract.adversarialWitness: A viewport intersecting every overlapping rectangle degrades to result-proportional nItem output.

fullScan.rationale: A full visit is permitted only when kPlacement itself equals nItem.

contract.proof: Measurements partition by axis and path-copy only changed row/column extent-index paths while retaining the region index.
contract.adversarialWitness: Changed tracks occupy disjoint leaves across both axes.

fullScan.rationale: Track measurement must retain and reuse the region interval index.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(log nRegion + cCandidate + kPlacement log kPlacement)

time.bound: O(log nRegion + cCandidate + kPlacement log kPlacement)

contract.proof: Range lookup prunes non-overlapping rows, filters candidates by columns, emits intersections, and restores domain order.
contract.adversarialWitness: Many row-spanning regions become candidates but only interleaved column intersections are emitted.

fullScan.rationale: Full work is allowed only when candidate/output cardinality itself reaches nRegion.
